{{Top|leg}}
The '''TIE training school'''<ref name="SWS1st">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] institution for training [[TIE pilot]]s. The school itself was based on the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Inflexible]]''. Flight Captain [[T. Alvak]] was one of its graduates.<ref name="SWS2nd">[[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the original entry of ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', Alvak was noted as attending the "TIE training school" aboard the Star Destroyer ''Inflexible''.<ref name="SWS1st" /> In the entry of the [[1994]] [[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Star Wars Sourcebook'', Second Edition]], this was changed to "Tir training school".<ref name="SWS2nd" /> This article assumes that the latter information is an error.
